macro_contract_detail: MOVE_TO_BRUSH_STATION / CLEAN_NOZZLE / MOVE_OUT_BRUSH_STATION are vendor machine-start macros. Their definitions are not present in this repository, so the nonblocking-preheat and station-park requirements are implemented against the documented adapter contract: the entry macro establishes a park, CLEAN_NOZZLE is synchronous, M104 is nonblocking and addresses the heater zone named by its T word, M109 blocks on that zone. No hardware verification is claimed.
